set.body: Baseline OLS slice of PRD X-13/X-14/X-16; owner decision 2026-09-18. A checked non-empty nominally keyed PredictorSet of Mass surfaces and a Mass response share a grid through Agreement. Implement native small tall-skinny Householder QR in design, reusable by eyesim-template, with explicit intercept policy, keyed coefficients, Signed fitted surface and Signed residual. Diagnostics are descriptive only: rank, conditioning/residual quality and R-squared where defined; no coefficient p-values or standard errors. Specify and test rank-deficient/underdetermined inputs, duplicate predictor keys, constant response, ordering and non-finite derived values as named errors or explicit undefined diagnostics. Preserve grid/frame identity and provenance. Acceptance: rational independent oracle, pinned eyesim template_regression and template_multireg under lm, intercept/no-intercept and ill-conditioned fixtures with named tolerances, JVM/JS coverage and runnable public API example. R may generate offline fixtures only; no R workflow/test dependency. Use per-ticket parity inputs/manifest. NNLS, simplex weights and partial association belong to bd-01M2T3ZCY7HJNFQ5G0Z6MQND0A and do not block this OLS slice.
